description.value: Khan Sahab Kitchen is an authentic Indian halal restaurant on Joyce Street in Vancouver's Renfrew-Collingwood neighbourhood, serving a broad menu spanning Punjabi classics, tandoori items, regional curries (chicken, lamb, goat, beef, and seafood), biryanis, and Indo-Chinese fusion dishes. The menu also features street-food snacks like Pani Puri, Vada Pav, and Rangooni Paratha alongside full thali platters, making it a substantial refuelling stop. Halal certification and a wide vegetarian selection make it accessible to riders with a range of dietary needs.
